packageRules.description: Keep the svelte toolchain moving as one unit. This matters most on MAJORS — typescript v7 and @sveltejs/kit have to land together or the build breaks. Below, the per-manager rules take over for patch/minor, so this rule is really about majors. Migrated off the deprecated matchPackagePrefixes to a glob.

RustCrypto crates are all 0.x, so every bump reads as a MAJOR to semver and would otherwise split into four separate MRs that don't compile apart (sha2 0.11 needs digest 0.11). Keep them welded together.

Lock-file-only updates, cargo. src-tauri/Cargo.toml pins by major only (tokio = "1", regex = "1", aws-sdk-s3 = "1"), so a 1.52 -> 1.53 bump touches Cargo.lock alone and cannot violate a declared constraint — verified on !101, whose entire diff is src-tauri/Cargo.lock. Together with the npm rule below these were 30 of the 74 dependency MRs merged by hand since 2026-05-01. Grouped per manager so a rust build failure never blocks the js batch, and vice versa.

Lock-file-only updates, npm. Same shape as the cargo rule — verified on !122, whose entire diff is package-lock.json. Also absorbs the blanket patch automerge this config used to carry as a standalone rule, so patches stay hands-off but arrive batched instead of one MR at a time.

Minor bumps that DO change a manifest. The built-in monorepo presets already group aws-sdk-rust/serde internally, but they still arrive as separate MRs every run — aws-sdk-rust alone was 9 of the 34 remaining hand-merges. One batch per side, reviewed rather than automerged because these change the declared range.
